propositions: The .bridge_state cache occupies 92% (≈950 MiB) of the 1.04 GiB tickets branch due to high churn in timestamp and rotation bookkeeping fields that are not read by the application

Deleting the baseline_advanced_at timestamp field and moving last_get_pass rotation bookkeeping out of bindings.json reduces marginal pack cost per version by 7.4× and 12.8× respectively, targeting ≤25% of the 12.79 KB baseline
The reconciler runs on ephemeral runners and requires .bridge_state to remain committed in git; the optimization keeps it on-branch while reducing churn rather than re-homing it

A stock git fast-export/fast-import history rewrite with --no-data filter achieves 8.4% final size (98.8 MiB from 1.17 GiB) while preserving all 49,888 commits and 2,661 merges and restoring byte-identical HEAD tree

Rollout gates require direct descendant workflow execution, explicit host process refresh, epoch mismatch fail-closed behavior at both union sites, and an off-repo backup bundle before publication under operator-attested quiescence
Post-publish rollback uses operator-controlled force-with-lease ref restoration with zero-session/stopped-MCP confirmation and mandatory writer re-clone to reject stale-epoch clones
